title: Reconciler for Token-metering & charge-attribution across Console pipelines
creator: Asha Patel
description: Background: The Console backend currently ingests streaming token events (generation, embedding, rerank) from the runtime and also receives batched usage records from Dedicated and Private deployments. These sources are processed by separate Kafka-based ETL jobs and stored in the analytics warehouse. Problem: billing attribution is inconsistent for cross-model fallbacks, multi-route requests, and cached responses. This ticket implements a reconciliation/reconciler job that joins the canonical token-meter stream with route, model-variant, and cache metadata to produce deterministic chargeable units used by billing and cost dashboards. Goals: build a fault-tolerant, idempotent job that performs hourly reconciliation, emits per-tenant token-attribution shards, supports retroactive backfills, and exposes a lightweight audit trail for disputes.
acceptance_criteria: Reconciler job runs hourly and completes within 15 minutes for top-10 tenants
Per-tenant CSV and parquet outputs are produced with fields: tenant_id, timestamp_hour, source_event_id, model_variant, route_id, tokens_total, tokens_billed, billing_reason
Matches between canonical meter and reconciled output >= 99.9% for synthetic validation dataset
Backfill job can reconcile 30 days of historic data within a day using parallel workers
Audit export API returns reconciliation decisions for a given tenant+hour within 5 seconds
Unit/integration tests cover fallback attribution, prefix cache hits, and deduplication edge cases
progress_notes: 2025-11-03: Spike completed to evaluate joining token events with cache metadata in Flink vs Beam. Chose Beam on Dataflow for managed autoscaling and existing SQL transforms.
2025-11-05: Prototype emits reconciled rows into staging.bigquery.reconciler_v1. Early schema stable but need to add billing_reason ENUM for fallback/cached/overage cases.
2025-11-09: Confirmed idempotency by including event_watermark + write_uuid; wrote dedupe logic to ignore duplicates from retry windows.

2025-11-12: Integration test failing for multi-route requests where one parent call fans out to two downstream models — agreed with PM to attribute tokens to primary route unless weight overrides provided.
2025-11-14: Security review kickoff scheduled; we will ensure PII-free outputs and KMS encryption for intermediate storage.
review_feedback: PM (Sofia Nguyen): Prefer deterministic attribution rules documented in PRD; no heuristics that change billing semantics without migration path.
Billing (Evan Cho): Need per-tenant monthly reconcile report for invoicing exceptions; keep raw events for 90 days for audits.
Design (Lina Zhao): Add a Console view to show reconciliation status and a drilldown to raw events for disputes.
implementation_notes: Architecture: Beam pipeline consuming kafka-token-events-v2 + cache-metadata-sync via pubsub snapshots; join keys: event_id, request_id, tenant_id, and time_bucket.
Storage: Staging writes to BigQuery partitioned by hour, final outputs snapshot to Google Cloud Storage as partitioned parquet for billing ingestion.
Idempotency: Use deterministic composite key (tenant_id|event_id|hour) and write_uuid check in BigQuery to avoid double-counting.
Monitoring: Add job-level SLOs (success rate 99.95%) and per-tenant drop alerts. Export metrics to Console telemetry with tags reconciler:v1.
Backfill: Implement a MapReduce-style backfill util that splits time ranges by tenant shard and replays historical kafka offsets into offline runner.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Late-arriving events can change attribution after billing window closes. Mitigation: Add 'finalize' window of 48 hours; mark rows provisional until finalize flag set.
Risk: Performance regressions for large enterprise tenants. Mitigation: shard by tenant and add autoscaling policy; provide manual on-demand reconcile for enterprise SLA customers.
Risk: Schema drift in upstream token events. Mitigation: enforce schema registry and add compatibility checks in CI.
next_steps: Finalize Beam transform and schema by EOD 2025-11-18
Complete end-to-end integration tests with staging Kafka and BigQuery by 2025-11-20
Ship v1 reconciler and enable feature-flagged telemetry in console-2025.11 release
